journey.sale: Keep one copy of each acquired card blueprint and up to the cost-cap maximum of each passive blueprint; sell only excess unselected identical copies after return
journey.route_rule: Use first route until it is cleared; then attempt C; after defeat retry the first route once before C; after clearing C alternate A and B
journey.card_rule: Retain the guard3 deck; report acquired cards as possessions but do not auto-swap the deck

limits: D52 and basic design 0.52 remain unchanged. Cost capacity, selection, free variant equipment and loot rules are trial choices, not new adopted rules.
Power probe is 12 loadouts x 3 routes x 2 decks x 2 public action policies x 8 seeds = 1152 independent fixed-entry runs. Ownership and 8 learning points are given solely for that comparison.
Slots examples can contain more total effect cost; their outcomes do not measure fairness between calibrated equivalent budgets.

Natural-start journey begins with 0 points and no acquired possessions, uses existing route unlocks and real traversals/resolutions, and adds the declared passive drop tables. It is not the unmodified AM/AN economy.

Loot uses a separate deterministic hash of seed, expedition index, route and reward source, independent of preparation policy and all engine random streams. Results are generated once per actual reward identity.

Home preparation uses authored route preferences and visible owned items, with no future encounter/draw/reward access. Factors for repeated bases are a selection heuristic, not diminishing game effects.
New drops inherit the originating reward's protection and outcome; sellable inventory is credited only at return. Previously owned items and actual historical learning refunds are preserved.

Retain and adapt use the same learning and sale rules; retain fills remaining capacity without removing already equipped items, adapt can choose a whole loadout again. All card decks remain guard3 in the journey.
Mechanical probes are not optimal agents or human evaluation. Clear-only timing is separate from defeats and cutoffs. No UI, world database content mechanics or final prices are adopted.
